description: One ISO 4032 M3 hexagon nut, Nut only, on the origin, with its thread modeled. The picture in the nut plugin's README is rendered from this design. Each step is one command; `caption` is the text a recording shows for it. A plugin step is a `plugin.run` whose `path` is relative to the repository and whose `approval` is the placeholder `@approval`: tests/examples_test.py fills both in, because the approval changes with every build of the plugin. `expect` is what that test measures: the box and volume of every body, as the build measured them.

steps.caption: An ISO 4032 M3 nut, on its own
